title: Incredible!
text: Highly enthusiastic 100% recommendation!  Gaby is such a warm person and was truly the best, and our experience was absolutely fabulous!  We went to quite a number of places (we lost count), and our tastings were above and beyond our expectations.  Gaby knows the ins and outs and all the people, and kept us going with details of cultural and gastronomic interest the entire time, as well as some introductions to some proprietors - definitely enthralling and soooo delicious!!  We haven’t stopped telling people about it.  Do yourself a favor and book with Gaby!
author: Rebecca_W

title: Different Better
text: This was a really great tour- Gabi was so nice and chatty & providing us a far more insightful view of how people socialise & meet In Granada enabling us to develop a personal relationship with her so easily…the bars & bodegas that were included were all for locals - we felt included & honoured
author: Noel_C

title: Great food, great host
text:
Gabriela was so knowledgeable and a great host and so obliging.
The tour was tailored to our choices
author: CatherineDickinson
